title: Battle of Frohnhofen
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Frohnhofen", at revision 1370110568, opens: "The Battle of Frohnhofen or Battle of Laufach took place on 13 July 1866 as part of the Main Campaign of the Prussian Army in the Austro-Prussian War. In a battle lasting several hours, the Prussian 26th Infantry Brigade repulsed attacks by the 3rd (Hessian) Division of the VIII. Corps of the North German Confederation, with the Hessians suffering heavy losses. It thus secured the Spessart crossings and created favorable conditions for the Battle of Aschaffenburg around the Main crossing the next day." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q609128, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of Frohnhofen". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
